name: Odylith Grounding
description: Bounded repo-grounding context engine inspired by Odylith.

repoRoot.label: Repository Root
repoRoot.help: Repo root used to resolve governed paths and explicit file anchors. Defaults to the current process working directory.

governanceRoot.label: Governance Root
governanceRoot.help: Tracked governance catalog consumed by the grounding engine. Defaults to governance/odylith-grounding under the repo root.

historyWindowMessages.label: History Window
historyWindowMessages.help: How many recent transcript messages the engine keeps before relying on the grounded packet.

maxCandidateComponents.label: Max Candidate Components
maxCandidateComponents.help: How many candidate components to surface when a request is still ambiguous.

dossierCharBudget.label: Dossier Character Budget
dossierCharBudget.help: Maximum dossier excerpt length injected into the system prompt for a grounded slice.
